description.vi: Kỹ năng và công cụ của một đội marketing: theo dõi nguồn, viết, duyệt, đăng và rút kinh nghiệm.
description.en: The know-how and tools of a marketing team that researches, writes, reviews, publishes and learns.

skills.name: marketing-radar
skills.description: Watch the sources the audience reads, triage them and keep the team's signals table and brief current.

skills.name: marketing-write
skills.description: Turn a signal into grounded article and social drafts in the hub; never publish.

skills.name: marketing-edit
skills.description: Review drafts against the brief and brand rules on a review task; fix small things, send the rest back.

skills.name: marketing-publish
skills.description: Take reviewed work live through the hub, hand off what a person must post, and never repeat an uncertain post.

skills.name: marketing-measure
skills.description: Read what the team shipped and what it led to, and keep the lessons in team memory.

skills.name: marketing-browser-post
skills.description: Publish, find, reply and unpublish on X, a Facebook Page and Reddit through the Soot-kept browser, from a signed marketing claim: signed-out, captcha and changed-layout checks, exact text, post URL, record or fail. Never posts twice.

skills.name: marketing-dispatch
skills.description: Without a hub: act on marketing_due — claim, publish through the channel's publisher, record, and file the one Cần bạn item (sign-in first).

skills.name: marketing-replies
skills.description: Read replies and comments on social channels, classify each (safe, complaint, money, account, flagged, spam), answer only safe ones through check and claim, and raise the rest as Cần bạn items.

skills.name: marketing-video
skills.description: Turn a published post or a chapter highlight into a short video with the 2build marketing-video (mvf) flow, then import its files as video drafts per channel for the Editor's check and the queue. Render failures and weak hooks stay drafts with the reason.

tools.name: radar_feeds
tools.title: Xem nguồn radar
tools.description: List the radar's sources (Reddit, Hacker News, dev.to, Medium, Lobsters, Product Hunt, vendor blogs, X searches) with when each was last read, its last error and how many new items it found.

tools.name: radar_scan
tools.title: Quét nguồn radar
tools.description: Read the sources that are due (each at most every 15 minutes; Reddit one feed per scan) and store new items once per URL. Returns the newest untriaged items. Not available from a customer conversation.

feeds.description: Feed ids from radar_feeds; omit for all.

max_new.description: How many new items to return.

tools.name: radar_items
tools.title: Xem tin radar
tools.description: List radar items by triage status (default new), optionally by feed, an accent-insensitive text query, or the last N hours.

feeds.description: Feed ids from radar_feeds; omit for all.

tools.name: radar_mark
tools.title: Phân loại tin radar
tools.description: Triage radar items in one call: each item kept (with the angle as note), dismissed, or used once written about. All or nothing: an unknown or repeated id changes none.

items.description: Every item to triage, each once.

note.description: For a kept item: product, angle and why now, one line.

tools.name: cms_list
tools.title: Xem danh sách bài CMS
tools.description: List the newest posts of a CMS site in every status (draft, published, archived) with revision, live flag and public URL. Check it before drafting so you never duplicate a topic.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

tools.name: cms_read
tools.title: Đọc một bài CMS
tools.description: Read the latest revision of a CMS post: body_markdown, revision, status and preview_url (a signed page showing exactly this revision, for anyone who reviews it before it goes live).

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

tools.name: cms_save
tools.title: Lưu bản nháp CMS
tools.description: Save a CMS draft revision; it never goes live (cms_publish does that). New post: expected_revision 0. Edit: the revision cms_read returned. Body is Markdown, at most 40000 bytes.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

request_id.description: A fresh UUID per change. Reuse it only to retry the exact same change after an unknown outcome.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown in blog lists and link previews.

tools.name: social_channels
tools.title: Xem kênh mạng xã hội
tools.description: Show each social channel: its length limit, whether the hub can post to it, and what you may do there.

tools.name: social_queue
tools.title: Tạo bản nháp mạng xã hội
tools.description: Queue a social post draft for one channel. Length is checked as the platform counts it (X: 280, link 23, accented letters 2). TikTok is a video: text is the caption and media_note the shot list and voice-over script.

request_id.description: A fresh UUID per change. Reuse it only to retry the exact same change after an unknown outcome.

link.description: https link the post points to, usually the CMS post URL.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

tools.name: social_list
tools.title: Xem bản nháp mạng xã hội
tools.description: List social posts, newest first, optionally by channel or status. Uncertain Facebook posts are looked up on the Page first. approved means released for X and waiting for the browser poster on the operator's computer. approval_asked_at is set on a draft whose revision waits for an operator's decision in Nest.

tools.name: social_update
tools.title: Sửa bản nháp mạng xã hội
tools.description: Edit or discard a draft, approved or failed social post. Pass the revision you listed. Changing an approved post takes it back from the X poster (it becomes a draft again). A publisher may reopen an uncertain post as draft once a human confirmed it was not posted.

tools.name: cms_publish
tools.title: Đăng hoặc gỡ bài trên CMS
tools.description: Take one reviewed CMS revision live (status published) or take a live post down (archived). Runs at once; it is public. Copy site, slug, revision and title from cms_read of that same revision; the hub refuses anything else.

site.description: The hub's site id for a blog (social_channels lists this team's sites).

slug.description: URL slug, lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Give each language its own slug (…-en, …-vi).

revision.description: The revision you reviewed; it must still be the latest.

title.description: The revision's title, exactly as cms_read returned it.

tools.name: social_publish
tools.title: Đăng bài lên mạng xã hội
tools.description: Post one reviewed social draft to its connected channel (X is posted by the browser poster on the operator's computer). Runs at once; it is public. Copy channel, text and link from social_list exactly: the hub refuses anything that differs from the queued post.

text.description: The queued text, exactly as social_list returned it.

link.description: The queued link, or null when the post has none.

tools.name: social_record
tools.title: Ghi link bài đã đăng tay
tools.description: Record a post a human made by hand (TikTok, or a channel the hub is not connected to) with its public URL.

tools.name: content_stats
tools.title: Xem số liệu nội dung
tools.description: What this team shipped in the last days, per site: articles that went live (with URL), drafts in progress and social posts published by channel. The hub counts what went out, not who read it: visits is always null.

site.description: One site; all of this team's sites when left out.

days.description: How many days back; 7 when left out.

tools.name: draft_save
tools.title: Lưu bản nháp
tools.description: Save a post draft in the pack's own storage (no hub): article, social, video or reply. A new draft needs request_id; an edit needs id and expected_revision. Returns the brief lint (title 30–60, meta 120–160, slug, ≥2 internal links, keyword). Never publishes.

parent.description: For kind "reply": the saved reply (R-…) it answers; only safe replies, or the fixed support pointer for an account question.

tools.name: items
tools.title: Xem bài
tools.description: List posts from pack storage by state, channel, campaign or an accent-insensitive search.

tools.name: check
tools.title: Kiểm tra bài
tools.description: The Editor's check of one exact revision: the automatic guard (facts from served sources, no personal data, platform rules, no duplicate, internal links open: a 404 fails) and your verdict. Any automatic failure forces fail; the post becomes ready or refused with its reason.

tools.name: schedule
tools.title: Xếp lịch đăng
tools.description: Queue a checked post. Without scheduled_at it takes the next free slot under the channel cap, spacing and quiet hours.

tools.name: due
tools.title: Việc đến hạn
tools.description: What is due (publish, reply, unpublish; late items never post on their own), needs (Cần bạn items) and ask, the one ready Cần bạn item to file now (refile: true files the sign-in again after a pick). wake/notify only for new work or a need not yet raised; resolves_need when none is left. The dispatch schedule passes schedule: true and skip: channels a tool chain publishes. With channel: {id, action} of the one due publish there for marketing_claim, or {done: true}.

tools.name: claim
tools.title: Nhận lượt đăng
tools.description: Claim one due post (publish), reply (reply) or removal (unpublish) for its publisher. Re-runs the guard, checks pause, cap, spacing, quiet hours, staleness and the Editor's verdict on this exact content, writes the intent record, then returns a signed claim; otherwise a refusal with its reason (done: true). With verify_first the publisher must look for an earlier post (find) and never post again.

tools.name: record
tools.title: Ghi đã đăng
tools.description: Record the publisher's result for a claim: the live URL. A tool chain passes the publisher's answer as is. A post returns the outcome {id: post_published, ref: url}; a reply or removal returns none.

tools.name: fail
tools.title: Ghi đăng lỗi
tools.description: Record that a claimed action did not happen (failed: retried later), needs a person (reason signed_out, layout_changed or captcha: pauses only that channel) or is uncertain (never claimed again until a person answers).

tools.name: pause
tools.title: Tạm dừng đăng
tools.description: Pause or resume publishing on every channel or on one channel. Writing and checking go on while paused.

signed_in.description: True with channel and paused true once you saw the person signed in on a channel paused as signed_out: its sign-in item ends; it stays paused until the person chooses Bật.

tools.name: page_view
tools.title: Xem trang marketing
tools.description: Bài viết / Hàng đợi / Chiến dịch page model: {page?, filter?, id?, campaign?}. The page id comes from the page context when omitted.

tools.name: page_action
tools.title: Đổi trang marketing
tools.description: Bài viết / Hàng đợi / Chiến dịch page action: pull, restore, reschedule, unpublish, set_limits (a channel's caps), pause, resume, campaign_save or campaign_refresh. Needs a request_id. Only campaign ops need PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY (optional).

tools.name: facts_sync
tools.title: Đọc giá và số liệu
tools.description: Read the product's served price/config source into facts; the guard accepts only prices and offers found there within 24 hours. url is optional: the source the schedule set is remembered. Without one, write with no prices or offers.

tools.name: gsc_sync
tools.title: Đọc Search Console
tools.description: Read Search Console numbers for published post URLs. Needs the Google sign-in; missing or revoked answers needs_person.

tools.name: seo_brief
tools.title: Gợi ý SEO
tools.description: Search queries worth a post (impressions ≥ 20 and position 8–20 or CTR under 1 %) and the published posts' 14-day numbers (null when not read yet).

tools.name: plan
tools.title: Kế hoạch bài hôm nay
tools.description: The daily content plan. wake: true is the schedule, tool-only: it queues a checked draft nobody scheduled, and wakes the Writer only for a free blog slot or a published post still to share on a signed-in social channel. Without wake it is the Writer's ready brief (query: a subject asked for): topic, keyword, angle, real novels with links, internal_links, titles to avoid, social (posts to share per channel). Saves the catalog it was given.

tools.name: channels_probe
tools.title: Kiểm tra đăng nhập kênh
tools.description: For a tool chain around the Editor's browser: with no result it names the next paused social channel's check page ({action: navigate, url}, the browser-use_control input) or {done: true}; with the page's result it decides signed in or out from the page text, unpauses only a channel the person confirmed that is really signed in, and sends a confirmed-but-signed-out one back to its sign-in card.

tools.name: report
tools.title: Báo cáo hằng ngày
tools.description: The Editor's daily report in at most six plain Vietnamese lines: what went out, the top posts by clicks or sign-ups, what the plan does next, stale drafts (once). Say the lines as they are.

tools.name: channels_setup
tools.title: Thiết lập kênh
tools.description: For a tool-only schedule: create missing channels (social ones paused until signed in) and fill only unset caps, account, rules, quiet hours, stale_after_h, the product name and the writer Soot. Never unpauses or overwrites an edit.

tools.name: raised
tools.title: Đã báo Cần bạn
tools.description: Mark due.needs items as filed with report_blocker (their key), so the dispatch schedule does not wake again for them.

tools.name: answer
tools.title: Áp dụng câu trả lời Cần bạn
tools.description: The person picked an option on a due.ask item: pass its key and the option label exactly (with url when they sent the live link). It applies the pick; then file the next due.ask.

tools.name: replies_sync
tools.title: Đọc phản hồi
tools.description: For the replies schedule: read watched Reddit threads by RSS, drop reader handles after 30 days, list replies to classify and channels to read. wake/notify only when there is something to do.

tools.name: reply_save
tools.title: Lưu phản hồi
tools.description: Save replies the Publisher read on one social channel with their class: safe (answer via draft_save kind reply, check, schedule), complaint, money, account, flagged (never answered; one Cần bạn item each; account also gets the fixed support pointer as a draft) or spam (ignored). Marks the channel's notifications read.

tools.name: video_import
tools.title: Nhận video từ mvf
tools.description: Read a finished 2build marketing-video (mvf) folder in the workspace (pretest decision, Micro Fish judge numbers, 08-delivery files, QA, captions, poster, platform copy) and save one kind "video" draft per channel (X, Facebook) with its assets. A render failure or a hook under the pretest bar stays a draft with the reason. Re-import updates the same drafts. Never publishes.

script.description: Script id; default the pretest winner.

parent.description: The source post (blog article) the video was cut from.

error.description: mvf's FAIL line when the render or export failed.

tools.name: campaign_save
tools.title: Lưu chiến dịch
tools.description: Create or update a campaign {name, goal{metric,target}, channels, starts, ends, token_budget}; makes one UTM short link per channel through the product api (PRODUCT_API_URL, needs PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY). Saving again fills links that failed.

tools.name: campaign_report
tools.title: Đọc số chiến dịch
tools.description: Read clicks and attributed signups per channel from the product api for running campaigns (or one id) and store them for Chiến dịch. Returns new signups as lead outcomes to record; with {id, tokens_used} also says when 80% of the token budget is used.

tools.name: campaign_verify
tools.title: Kiểm tra khoá chiến dịch
tools.description: Check the saved admin key with one read-only request: state ok, wrong_key or no_role.

PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY.title: Khoá admin sản phẩm
PRODUCT_ADMIN_KEY.description: Khoá API tạo trong trang quản trị của sản phẩm, có quyền tạo liên kết chiến dịch và đọc báo cáo chiến dịch; Soot dùng để tạo liên kết rút gọn cho chiến dịch và đọc số lượt bấm, đăng ký theo chiến dịch. Chỉ gửi tới địa chỉ api PRODUCT_API_URL. Nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat.

MARKETING_HUB.title: Marketing hub
MARKETING_HUB.description: Kết nối tới marketing hub của sản phẩm: các site, kênh và quyền đăng của nhóm này. Lấy ở trang quản trị hub; nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat.

MARKETING_CLAIM_KEY.title: Khoá ký lượt đăng
MARKETING_CLAIM_KEY.description: Một chuỗi bí mật dài (ví dụ 32 byte ngẫu nhiên) dùng để ký mỗi lượt đăng. Nhập cùng giá trị cho gói đăng bài (publisher) của kênh; nhập trong Nest, không nhập trong chat.

FILE_ROOT.title: Thư mục làm việc
FILE_ROOT.description: Thư mục làm việc của cuộc trò chuyện, nơi mvf để video đã dựng. Nest cấp tự động; công cụ video_import chỉ đọc tệp trong thư mục này.

GSC_GOOGLE.title: Google Search Console
GSC_GOOGLE.description: Đăng nhập Google trong Nest để Soot đọc số hiển thị, lượt bấm và vị trí của các bài đã đăng (chỉ quyền đọc Search Console).

tables.description: Cài đặt chung: giờ yên tĩnh, xếp lịch, ngưỡng bài lỡ giờ.

tables.name: channels
tables.description: Các kênh đăng bài: bật hay dừng, giới hạn mỗi ngày.

tables.name: sources
tables.description: Nguồn Soot đọc để tìm ý viết bài.

tables.name: signals
tables.description: Ý tưởng Soot nhặt từ các nguồn.

tables.name: posts
tables.description: Mọi bài viết và bài đăng, trạng thái, liên kết.

tables.name: assets
tables.description: Ảnh và video đi kèm bài.

tables.name: checks
tables.description: Kết quả kiểm bài trước khi xếp lịch.

tables.name: queue
tables.description: Hàng đợi: bài nào đăng lên kênh nào, lúc nào.

tables.name: publish_log
tables.description: Nhật ký mỗi lần đăng hoặc thử đăng.

tables.name: replies
tables.description: Bình luận Soot đọc và cách xử lý.

tables.name: metrics
tables.description: Số liệu theo ngày: lượt hiển thị, lượt bấm, lượt xem.

tables.name: facts
tables.description: Thông tin về sản phẩm (giá, tính năng) bài được phép nêu.

tables.name: campaigns
tables.description: Các chiến dịch: mục tiêu, ngân sách token, kết quả.

tables.description: Liên kết theo dõi của chiến dịch, kênh, bài.

tables.description: Việc đã báo bạn, để không báo lặp.
